episodes.name: Little Sister Don'tcha
episodes.overview: J.T. and Rich are excited about going on dates, but J.T. didn't expect Al to be invited.

episodes.name: Three Girls and a Baby
episodes.overview: With Frank and Carol out for dinner, Dana, Karen and Al are left to watch their new baby sister.

episodes.name: Party Animal
episodes.overview: Cody, J.T. and Mark suspect their new neighbor is a jewel thief. Meanwhile, Dana moves out and loosens up a little too much.

episodes.name: Midnight Caller
episodes.overview: While working on the Family Helpline, J.T. and Dana mishandle a call from a troubled teen.

episodes.name: Maid to Order
episodes.overview: J.T. hires an aspiring model to be the family's maid; and Carol gets overly involved in Karen's cheerleading tryouts.

episodes.name: Don't Ask
episodes.overview: Tired of the kids acting "either lazy, selfish or brain-dead," Frank and Carol order them to fend for themselves.

episodes.name: Hello, Mister Chips
episodes.overview: Al takes a job at a cookie store and has to work alongside the company mascot, Mr. Chips the chimpanzee.

episodes.name: Roadie
episodes.overview: Cody's a roadie---"the coolest job in the world"---for singer Christi Rose, who asks him to become her bodyguard.

episodes.name: The Wall
episodes.overview: Mark scores points for the guys on the "geek wall" at a dance; Dana attempts to stir interest in a feminist study group; Frank and Carol experience a day at a health spa.

episodes.name: Baby Come Back
episodes.overview: J.T. and Al have dollar signs in their eyes when they take Lily to audition for a commercial.

episodes.name: The Fight Before Christmas
episodes.overview: Frank and Carol set up Al on a blind date with their friends' equally reticent son.

episodes.name: What's Wrong with This Picture?
episodes.overview: J.T. receives an offer he can't refuse: the chance to go out with a gangster's daughter.

episodes.name: Beautiful Ladies of Wrestling
episodes.overview: To win Super Bowl tickets, Frank and J.T. dress up as cheerleaders and face off against a pair of women wrestlers named Assault and Battery.

episodes.name: Torn Between Two Mothers
episodes.overview: When Frank's mother and Carol can't agree on child-rearing philosophies, Frank's caught in the middle of the power struggle.

episodes.name: Snow Bunnies
episodes.overview: Al feels compelled to check up on Matt when she learns he'll be on a ski trip with Stephanie "Love Boat" Leifer.

episodes.name: Secret Admirer
episodes.overview: Carol gets really ticked when Frank buys her a fake designer watch for Valentine's Day.

episodes.name: Forever Young
episodes.overview: A flirtatious girl disproves J.T.'s claim that a guy "would never trash a friendship over some stupid chick."

episodes.name: Guess Who's Coming to Dinner?
episodes.overview: Dana brings her boyfriend Fleming home, and he promptly psychoanalyzes Frank.

episodes.name: Do the Right Thing
episodes.overview: J.T. decides to rely on brain power to boost his grades rather than use a cheat sheet procured by his friend Rich.

episodes.name: The Bodyguard Formerly Known as Prince
episodes.overview: Dana, Karen and Al meet a prince and his two assistants on a ski weekend, but the girls don't know which is the real royal.

episodes.name: Major Pain
episodes.overview: Dana, J.T. and Rich take career-placement tests; Frank deals with an overly eager employee.

episodes.name: We're Going to Disney World (1)
episodes.overview: Frank's mom treats everyone to a trip to Disney World, but there's some unexpected baggage---Rich and Flash.

episodes.name: We're Going to Disney World (2)
episodes.overview: During a trip to Disney World, Flash tries to break a record for visiting every attraction.

episodes.name: Men at Work
episodes.overview: When the local bar goes belly-up, Frank buys everything so he can turn his basement into a lounge for his guy friends.
